releases.notes:
This is another small release mainly focusing on two things:

 - Add Training Dummy (creative-only, maybe I will change this at some point?)
 - Fix issues with Blunderbuss (and some other weapons) (#214)

Just a small release this time :) But this one took quite some time!

 - Port changes to 1.9.4
 - Port changes to 1.10+
 - Port changes to 1.11+
 - Fix crash on 1.12(.1)
 - Small cleanups

These are just some hotfixes on top of the recent 0.7.6 release.

 - Add Zombie Weapon Chance config option
 - Update Gradle even further
 - Better Creative Tab icon handling
 - Fix a few item models
 - Fix Infinity enchant
 - Remove goalseeker ID
 - Fix Crossbow bolt not doing damage
 - Fix a few weapons dealing too little or no damage
 - Add Turkish translation (by @TurkishAhmet4545)
 - Fix Darts not being consumed properly

Almost **5 years**... Wow! This mod was recently added to Tekkit 2 which is pretty cool. Well, let's don't let them hanging and fix a few things!
A big thank you to @phantamanta44, especially!


 - [DELAYED] Maybe I will port some of the changes to 1.11, 1.10, and 1.9... But not for now...
 - [FIXED] Too many things!

So, it's time for a last release before I start working on the 0.8-weapons ;) Here are a "few" fixes I have made:

 - [ADDED] Support for 1.12, 1.12.1 and 1.12.2 with the 1.12-jar
 - [ADDED] Ore Dictionary Recipes
 - [ADDED] More config options
 - [ADDED] Resource pack for old Balkon's textures (see CurseForge page)
 - [FIXED] Every bug reported (on GitHub and OpenEye)
 - [FIXED] Mace not stunning properly
 - [FIXED] Recipes in 1.12 (MUCH FIXES)

This is the last update I will release for 1.8 and 1.8.9.
Why? Because it is a pain to update it. It takes just *MUCH TOO LONG*.
Well, but enjoy this last update for it ;)
BUT this is the first update for 1.12+! Enjoy this version ^^
